connectorUiConfig.title: QCrypton PQC Scanner (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The **QCrypton PQC Scanner** connector polls the QCrypton API for post-quantum cryptography readiness findings and ingests them into Microsoft Sentinel via the Codeless Connector Framework. Findings include Key Vault key posture (RSA/ECC vs. PQ-hybrid), TLS certificate signature algorithms on public endpoints, Storage Account and App Service TLS configuration, and CMK provenance.

Data is written to the `PQReadiness_CL` custom table.

sampleQueries.description: All quantum-vulnerable findings in the last 24h
sampleQueries.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceName, AssetKind, Algorithm, PostureReason, RiskScore
| order by RiskScore desc

sampleQueries.description: Vulnerable Key Vault keys grouped by subscription
sampleQueries.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where AssetKind == 'kv-key' and QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| summarize count() by SubscriptionId, Algorithm

sampleQueries.description: TLS certs expiring after 2030 still using classical signatures
sampleQueries.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where AssetKind in ('tls-cert', 'kv-cert') and QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| where ExpiresOn > datetime(2030-01-01)
| project ResourceName, AssetIdentifier, SignatureAlgorithm, ExpiresOn, RiskScore

dataTypes.name: PQReadiness_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
PQReadiness_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

properties.description: AppServiceLegacyTLS_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.1

An Azure App Service is configured to accept inbound TLS below 1.3. Only TLS 1.3 supports
the negotiation of hybrid PQ key exchange (X25519MLKEM768 etc.); legacy versions cannot be
upgraded to PQ without a client protocol change.
properties.displayName: App Service using TLS < 1.3
properties.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AssetKind == "tls-config"
| where ResourceType =~ "microsoft.web/sites"
| where QuantumPosture in ("vulnerable", "partial")
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceId, ResourceName, PostureReason, RiskScore, SubscriptionId, ResourceGroup
| order by RiskScore desc

properties.displayName: App Service using TLS < 1.3

properties.description:
A TLS or Key Vault certificate has an expiry date after 2030-01-01 and is signed with a
quantum-vulnerable classical algorithm. Long-lived certificates are the primary harvest-now-
decrypt-later risk vector. Reissue with a PQ-hybrid signature or shorten validity window.
properties.displayName: Certificate expiring after 2030 still uses classical signature
properties.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AssetKind in ("tls-cert", "kv-cert")
| where QuantumPosture == "vulnerable"
| where isnotnull(ExpiresOn) and ExpiresOn > datetime(2030-01-01)
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceId, ResourceName, AssetIdentifier, SignatureAlgorithm, ExpiresOn, RiskScore, SubscriptionId, ResourceGroup
| order by ExpiresOn desc

properties.displayName: Certificate expiring after 2030 still uses classical signature

properties.description:
A resource with quantum-vulnerable posture appeared that was not observed in the previous
24-hour scan cycle. Investigate whether this is a new deployment that should have been
provisioned with PQ-hybrid cryptography from the start.
properties.displayName: New quantum-vulnerable resource appeared
properties.query:
let previous = PQReadiness_CL
  | where TimeGenerated between (ago(2d) .. ago(1d))
  | where QuantumPosture == "vulnerable"
  | distinct AssetIdentifier;
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where QuantumPosture == "vulnerable"
| where AssetIdentifier !in (previous)
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceId, ResourceName, AssetIdentifier, AssetKind, Algorithm, PostureReason, RiskScore, SubscriptionId, ResourceGroup

properties.displayName: New quantum-vulnerable resource appeared

properties.description: QuantumVulnerableKVKey_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.1

A key in Azure Key Vault has been classified as quantum-vulnerable (RSA or elliptic-curve).
These key types are broken by Shor's algorithm on a sufficiently large fault-tolerant quantum computer.
Rotate to a PQ-hybrid key (ML-KEM, ML-DSA) or plan migration before the harvest-now-decrypt-later
window closes for long-lived data.
properties.displayName: Quantum-vulnerable key detected in Key Vault
properties.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where AssetKind == "kv-key"
| where QuantumPosture == "vulnerable"
| extend AlgorithmDetail = strcat(Algorithm, iif(isnotnull(KeySize), strcat("-", tostring(KeySize)), ""))
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceId, ResourceName, AssetIdentifier, AlgorithmDetail, PostureReason, RiskScore, SubscriptionId, ResourceGroup
| order by RiskScore desc

properties.displayName: Quantum-vulnerable key detected in Key Vault

properties.description: WeakTLSCertOnGateway_AnalyticalRules Analytics Rule with template version 3.0.1

An Application Gateway or Front Door is presenting a TLS certificate signed with a classical
algorithm (RSA / ECDSA) that is quantum-vulnerable. If the certificate's validity extends past
the plausible arrival of cryptographically-relevant quantum computers, replace with a PQ-hybrid
certificate now.
properties.displayName: Public TLS certificate with classical signature on Application Gateway
properties.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where AssetKind == "tls-cert"
| where QuantumPosture == "vulnerable"
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceId, ResourceName, AssetIdentifier, SignatureAlgorithm, ExpiresOn, RiskScore, SubscriptionId, ResourceGroup
| order by RiskScore desc

properties.displayName: Public TLS certificate with classical signature on Application Gateway

properties.description: An Entra ID app registration or service principal has a certificate credential using a classical algorithm (RSA or elliptic-curve) that is vulnerable to Shor's algorithm. These certificates authenticate workloads and service-to-service flows. Rotate to a PQ-hybrid certificate or shorten the validity window.
properties.displayName: Quantum-vulnerable certificate on Entra app registration
properties.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AssetKind in ("entra-app-cert", "entra-sp-credential")
| where QuantumPosture == "vulnerable"
| extend AppId = extract(@'"appId":"([^"]+)"', 1, Metadata)
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceName, AssetIdentifier, Algorithm, KeySize, PostureReason, RiskScore, ExpiresOn, AppId
| order by RiskScore desc

properties.displayName: Quantum-vulnerable certificate on Entra app registration

Post-quantum cryptography readiness for Microsoft Sentinel.
